129710.overview: Fruit Machine is a gambling game simulating a simple slot machine. The player spins the reels by hitting return then uses keys 1 to 3 to hold or nudge the corresponding reels when the game gives the option to do so. Pressing 4 respins the nudges and delete cancels holds. The player starts out with five pounds and each spin costs 10p. Matching the first two reels is worth 20p. Three plums, cherries, grapes, pears and oranges are worth 40p while, three melons or bells are worth 100p and three bars are worth 200p.
